webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: The webhooks alerts are sent to, their latest deliveries and a test notification.
webhooks.serverOnly: Webhooks are configured on the server only: the [[webhooks]] section of arcilogger.toml, and "arcilogger-core secret set webhook.<name>.secret" for the secret. The browser neither adds nor changes a webhook; see INSTALL.md.
webhooks.locked: Security rules are not enabled in your licence: no notifications are sent to webhooks and no test notification can be sent.
webhooks.caption: Configured webhooks
webhooks.emptyHint: To add a webhook, write a [[webhooks]] section into arcilogger.toml on the server (INSTALL.md).
webhooks.verifyHint: It is not confirmed that the target accepts this format; check that the first notification arrives.

test.title: Test notification: {{name}}
test.ok: The test notification was sent; the target answered HTTP {{status}}.
test.failed: The test notification could not be sent: {{error}}

deliveries.title: Deliveries: {{name}}
deliveries.description: The latest 50 deliveries, newest first. A failed delivery is retried for 24 hours.
deliveries.empty: No notification has been sent to this webhook yet.
